title: Israel-based Oak, which is building an AI-native identity access management system, comes out of stealth with a $60M seed (Anna Heim/TechCrunch)
summary: Anna Heim / TechCrunch: Israel-based Oak, which is building an AI-native identity access management system, comes out of stealth with a $60M seed — Physical badges used to be all you needed for identity management at a company.
